label: UI
tooltip: Language, which tabs and trackers to show, and chat messages.

open_on_occult_crescent_entry.label: Open BOCCHI on Occult Crescent entry

use_bocchi_theme.label: Use BOCCHI theme
use_bocchi_theme.tooltip: Draw BOCCHI's windows in its navy and gold colours. Turn off to use your Dalamud colours.

show_active_treasure_tracker.label: Show active bronze / silver
show_active_treasure_tracker.tooltip: Show how many bronze and silver coffers are left when you hover the tracker line. The numbers update when Treasure Sight is used.

show_bocchi_chat_prefix.label: Show BOCCHI chat messages
show_bocchi_chat_prefix.tooltip: Print BOCCHI's messages in your chat, marked [BOCCHI]. The message of the day always shows.

show_reward_icons.label: Show reward icons
show_reward_icons.tooltip: Demiatma, field note and soul shard icons in the FATE and CE lists.
